brief:
Georgetown University scholar Badar Khan Suri, who was previously detained, is fighting deportation proceedings initiated by the U.S. government, according to Zeteo. The case centers on his public speech expressing support for Palestine, which authorities have used as grounds for removal action against him.

Suri maintains that "hopelessness is a crime," signaling his determination to continue his legal challenge despite facing significant obstacles in court. The deportation case involves tensions between academic freedom and political speech in the United States, particularly regarding commentary on Middle Eastern conflicts.
dek: Formerly detained Georgetown scholar Badar Khan Suri is fighting an uphill legal battle against his deportation, but says ‘hopelessness is a crime.’…
title: U.S. pursues deportation of Georgetown scholar over Palestine advocacy
